error.storage: The data on this device could not be read or saved.
error.crypto: A security check failed. Please try again.
error.network: No connection with your other devices. It will retry.
error.secret: The system keystore is not available.
denied.cooldown: Wait {minutes} min before the next pass.
denied.unknown_goal: Unknown goal, or not active today.
denied.method_not_allowed: That method is not accepted for this goal.
denied.plan_laxer: Today's plan can only be made stricter.
denied.no_key_goal: The plan needs at least one goal that unlocks.
denied.guardian_only: Only your guardian can relax the rules; you can ask them.
denied.invalid_domain: That is not a valid website address.
denied.too_many_requests: You already have several requests waiting for an answer.
denied.auth_required: Unlock with your PIN, password or pattern first.
denied.method_not_set: That method is not set up.
denied.needs_contact: This change needs your trusted contact's approval.
settings.title: Settings
settings.report_lead: Versions, states and counts only: never your goals, names, sites or keys. Read it before sharing it.
settings.erase_lead: Empties this computer's database and replaces every key, so nothing stored before can be read again. Uninstalling does not delete it; this does. Your other devices keep their own copy until you delete it on each one.
settings.unlock_lead: To continue, unlock with a method set up on your phone.
settings.no_typed_method: On this computer you can only unlock with a PIN, password or pattern. Set one up on your phone first.
settings.erase_needs_contact: With a trusted contact, first turn off “My changes need my trusted contact's approval” on your phone (with their approval, or it takes effect in 7 days).
settings.erase_confirm: This cannot be undone: your profile, goals and history on this computer will be gone.
verify.unavailable: This method is not available on this computer.
verify.no_result: The session stopped without a result.
verify.sandbox_failed: The isolated verifier could not be opened.
verify.not_confirmed: It could not be confirmed this time. You can try again or use another option.
home.close_note: Closing this window does not stop the protection.
home.silent_body: If you turned it off, that's fine. If not, check that the app is still active on that device.
home.sentence_locked.one: Complete the remaining goal to unlock. Continue with “{goal}”.
home.sentence_locked.other: Complete {n} goals to unlock. Continue with “{goal}”.
home.sentence_emergency: Everything is available. It is recorded.
home.sentence_focus: Your session keeps counting while you look at the day.
home.sentence_free_day: No goals and no blocking on any device today.
onb.title: Welcome to ProcastinaciOFF
onb.subtitle: Your goals first; everything else, later. Everything is processed on your devices and travels encrypted.
onb.free_days_hint: (no goals or blocking, and no bedtime the night before)
onb.anti_impulse: Relaxing these rules later only takes effect the next day; tightening them, immediately.
onb.fixed_goals_hint: They appear every morning in the day plan. You can add more there.
onb.essential_apps: Essential apps (always, except during sleep), one per line
onb.join_instructions: On the other device open “Pair a device” and copy the code. Paste it here:
onb.check_code: Check that the other device shows:
onb.confirm_there: Confirm there. This screen will move on by itself.
plan.lead_adding: You can add goals or raise targets. What is already there cannot be removed until tomorrow.
plan.lead_morning: Set your goals for today. Once confirmed they stay fixed until tomorrow: after that you can only add or raise them.
plan.empty: No goals yet. Add at least one that unlocks.
plan.name: Name
plan.note: Any goal can be marked as done after a 60 s wait. The camera never records: it only counts whether it was done.
plan.need_key: You need at least one goal that unlocks.
focus.time_up: Time's up. You can finish now.
focus.declare_instruction: Write in one sentence what you did. After 60 s you can mark it as done.
focus.declare_note: It is not saved or sent: it only counts as “self-declared”.
focus.instruction: Sit down, open what you need and keep going. Only this task's apps are available.
focus.camera_note: nothing is recorded · the verifier has no Internet access
shield.sleep_lead: Calls keep working. You wake up at {time}.
shield.grace_lead: In {seconds} s the apps that are not allowed right now will close.
shield.focus_only: During focus only your task's apps are available.
shield.set_goals: Set your goals for today to get started.
shield.not_done: You haven't met today's goals yet. Continue with “{goal}”.
shield.set_goals_unlock: Set your goals for today to unlock.
pair.title: Pair another device
pair.instructions: Open ProcastinaciOFF on the phone, choose “Join a profile” and scan this code.
pair.expires: The code expires in 10 minutes. Your goals travel encrypted.
pair.match_question: Does the other device show this number?
family.sent: Sent: {what}. Your guardian gets a notification.
family.mirror_note: Your guardian sees exactly this, no more and no less.
family.no_alerts: No alerts in the last 7 days.
family.never_sees: They never see your messages, contacts, photos, browsing history or location: those don't exist in the system.
family.granted: Granted without network (code or the guardian in person)
family.blocked_sites.one: {n} site blocked by category (never which one)
family.blocked_sites.other: {n} sites blocked by category (never which ones)
tamper.permission_revoked: A protection permission was turned off
tamper.uninstall_attempt: Someone tried to uninstall the app
tamper.safe_mode: The device started in safe mode
emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.cost.one: It costs {n} pass tomorrow and is recorded.
emergency.cost.other: It costs {n} passes tomorrow and is recorded.
emergency.not_saved: The reason is not saved or sent to anyone.
emergency.ready: You can use the emergency now
